title: SciPy: Scientific Computing in Practice
description: Use optimization, statistics, sparse structures, and signal tools without treating SciPy as a black box.
learningOutcomes: Select the right SciPy subpackage for a numerical task
Interpret solver outputs and failure modes
Work efficiently with sparse and signal data

lessons.title: Optimization and Root Finding
lessons.description: Solve bounded numerical problems and inspect convergence.

lessons.title: Statistical Distributions and Tests
lessons.description: Use scipy.stats for simulation, estimation, and careful inference.

lessons.title: Sparse Arrays and Linear Solvers
lessons.description: Represent mostly-empty data and solve sparse systems efficiently.

lessons.title: Signal Processing and Real Data
lessons.description: Filter, transform, and detect features in sampled time-series signals.
